notes.title: Grimoire of the Sage - Update
notes.content:
Update focused on increasing the content and the possibilities of creating strategies for the game.
Focused on new skills of all kinds, this new update brings new content to explore.

Check out the full changelist:

[h2]NEW SKILLS[/h2]

[b]- Heal (Magic)[/b]
Heals himself and his close allies based on the spirit of Frej. Increases healing as the skill evolves.

[b]- Rose of life (Magic)[/b]
Rose that heals Frej and allies over a period of time. Increases time and healing as the skill evolves.

[b]- Deflection (Energy)[/b]
Relepe attacks. The deflection gets stronger as the skill level is increased.

[b]- Fast steps (Energy)[/b]
Increases Frej's speed for a while. Increases speed and duration as the skill evolves.

[b]- Strong Beat (Energy)[/b]
The heart makes a big beat, hitting all enemies around it based on Frej's damage. Increases damage as the skill evolves.

[h2]NEW CLOTHES[/h2]

- Frej Negro Gatto
- Frej Gabs


[h2]IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]

- "Spirit" status now adds "Healing power" (used by the new abilities).
- Increased Purple Crystals reward in new daily missions.
- New functionality: Zoom with the mouse scroll.
- Improved particle effects of energy abilities.
- Fixed scrolling menus that started in the middle of the list. Now they start at the top.

Thanks again for the feedbacks. We will continue to evolve together!

[b]See you around, guardians![/b]

notes.title: REFROZEN Update
notes.content:
Taking into account all the feedback from the public, we made several changes to the game with this update.
The focus is on making the game more frantic, more challenging, fun and less idle.
The REFROZEN update has arrived to fulfill most of these requests.

Check out the full changelist:

REBALANCING

- Redone monsters summoning time in all scenarios;
- Battle difficulty in all monsters has been rebalanced;
- The difficulty of all the bosses of the game has been rebalanced.

CORRECTIONS

- Corrected the degree of healing of the ability "Polar Vampire";
- HDR graphics improvements for post-processing and lighting effects;
- Fixed bug in the settings that inverted the MIDDLE and LOW graphics;
- Decreased the firing force of the minion egg summon, which was causing falls in unrestricted scenarios.
- Performance improvement for FPS gain.
- Slot type indicators when equipping skills in the menu.

NEW SKILLS

- Frigid Presence (Passive)
Inflicts damage to nearby enemies. Increases damage and decreases attack time as the skill evolves.

[previewyoutube=BE8U7dOJt2E;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you all for the feedbacks! We will continue to evolve the game together more and more.

See you around, guardians!

notes.title: New Boss: Lady Tuny (High Bridges)
notes.content:
Capable of summoning powerful fire tornadoes and hurling black crystal projectiles, Lady Tuny is the first fully flying monster in the game, being able to fly and land freely throughout the scene.

In this, Frej ends up discovering that he can also float! And by defeating Lady Tuny, this new ability is unlocked for use on other maps, including the High Bridges, making it easier to get around the grand scenery.

Each boss is a unique battle with different strategies. Discover the best way to defeat it!

Check out our full changelist:

- Improved mouse movement;

- New functionality: Float around the scene

- Some graphical improvements

- Knockout animation bug fix

- Minor improvements in the display of the user interface

- New Skill: Titan Hammer

notes.title: Mouse Gameplay
notes.content:
Upon request, the gameplay functionality via mouse was implemented.

It is now possible to walk and attack with Frej, making the controls more dynamic. Wherever the mouse aims, Frej will attack or walk. It is possible to combine the two buttons to cause both actions.

notes.title: Cold Heart is available
notes.content:
Cold Heart has become the project of our lives. The first child, who we love too much.

Since it is already completely ready to play, the game is now available.

We want to get closer to the feedback from our community to make this game our face, from gamer to gamer, relying heavily on everyone's opinion.

Therefore, we are very happy to publish with a 20% initial discount.

Thanks to everyone who made this possible! Friends, testers and all of our supporters. You guys are awesome!

We will continue to improve with weekly updates and a lot of content yet to come. Feel free to give all kinds of feedback and, above all, have a lot of fun!

See you around, guardian.

notes.title: Daily Missions
notes.content:
To increase the range of content in Cold Heart, we created the new "Daily Missions" feature, which will need to perform 5 specific and random tasks that must be completed by the end of the day. If he succeeds, the player will release the last mission which will give even more rewards!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZLFzCh8_d.webp?maxwidth=760&fidelity=grand [/img]

Missions are generated randomly based on the content already unlocked by the player (Scenarios, monsters and rankings). For example:

If the player has the "Crystal Cave" released up to difficulty B, missions may ask the player to defeat enemies from the "Crystal Cave" between difficulty D and B.

The rewards are very generous, and the challenges are very well thought out.

See you around, guardian!

notes.title: DEMO version is now available!
notes.content:
We are very confident in the quality of our beloved game, so we want everyone to try it out before buying it!

It is a small demo, but able to demonstrate how the gameplay works and the start of the game.

This version is available in the 4 final release languages ​​(English, Portuguese, French and Spanish) and does not influence your save game. Each game played is restarted without saving or compromising any occasional files previously created.

Try it now! I guarantee you will not be disappointed ːsteamhappyː

See you around, guardian.
